g.text: Edit every rally in the reviewed parent

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #162536

g.text: What review can fix depends on the permitted human action

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Ideal human review · evidence order · whole flagged production parent plus playback context

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536171

g.text: Left: accept a proposed start within 1 second with material rally overlap; correct its type. Separate-end policies also correct that accepted rally’s end.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536171

g.text: Confirmation can omit unproposed rallies. Right: a stronger upper bound that discovers and edits all rallies inside the reviewed parent.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536171

g.text: Points use 5%, 10%, 20%, and 40% per-video review caps; actual workload may be lower. Three-seed means, pooled within each seed.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536171

g.text: Exports remain exactly production’s. Review footage is not measured labor. Development results; chronological-order comparisons are in the full report.
